title: Turning historical state into useful computation
subtitle: Muon-RT · Six-step video post-training · GLA
intro: Two delayed main readings: teacher displacement as a history of applied updates, and alignment after video distillation. The classic examines GLA: input-dependent forgetting in matrix states and hardware-efficient chunking. Original dates are retained; these are not first releases today.

blocks.text: 37.7GB/GPU measures persistent memory between steps after freeing gradients, not peak memory; momentum-free Muon uses the same. Convergence assumes PL, smoothness, drift and alignment conditions; single-batch cosine does not establish an advantage.[1]

classic.title: Which directions to forget, and how to parallelize them
classic.dateNote: First posted 2023-12-11; read v6 (2024-08-27), sections 2–5; ICML 2024
classic.evidence: Read recurrence, parallel form, chunking and gating ablations; equivalent column-vector notation

recognition.label: ICML 2024 · Important historical work on linear attention (official PMLR record checked 2026-11-02)

classic.question: With fixed matrix-state size, how do effective memory, recall and numerical stability change together when gates remain near zero or one?

blocks.text: Linear Transformers (2020) express attention as matrix recurrence; RetNet (2023) adds fixed decay. GLA selects decay directions from each input while retaining chunkwise computation.[4,5]
Single-head core: q and k are d_k-dimensional columns, v is d_v-dimensional, and S has shape d_k×d_v. Output gating, multi-head normalization and projection are omitted.[4]

blocks.label: Input-dependent rowwise forgetting; paper gates use a low-rank map, sigmoid and temperature [4]
Unrolled recurrence; an empty product is all ones; this is not softmax normalization [4]
Parallel form with elementwise products/ratios; cumulative products can underflow [4]
Equivalent chunk identity on [a,b]: recurrent boundary state, parallel within-chunk work

blocks.text: Implementation uses secondary tiling: half-precision matmuls between sub-chunks and full-precision log-space work within them. Materializing boundary states trades I/O and memory for sequence parallelism.[4]
